provenance: Hand-authored provider payloads for offline runs. None came from a model and none is evidence about any model. The valid ones are PromisePatch's own deterministic passage for the same facts -- a stand-in whose only job is to be accepted -- and the rest are written to exercise one rejection branch each. No reference explanation from the dataset appears here, so a scripted run cannot smuggle one into a payload either. No wording is shared with any reference passage, so a leakage test can assert the absence rather than reason about whether a scripted answer counts as a prompt.
